\[
I_{\text{out}}(p) = \frac{1}{|B(p)|} \sum_{q \in B(p)} I(q),
\qquad n = 8
\]

The formula shows the default parameter values.

where

- \(B(p)\): The block that holds pixel p
- \(n\): The block size

B(p) is the block that holds pixel p. Blocks start at the top-left corner of the image and are n by n pixels. At the right and bottom edges, blocks can be smaller, and they average the pixels they have. Every pixel of a block gets the same mean. This is a box filter sampled once per block and repeated. Pillow's reduce followed by nearest-neighbor enlarging gives the same means.
